errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: We could not find that record.

login.headline: Run your warehouse and office from one place
login.subhead: Real-time inventory, scan-first fulfillment, manufacturing, and embedded B2B payments — on one system.

profile.title: Personal settings
profile.photoHelp: Update your profile photo for the office header
profile.photoCompressed: Photos are compressed on-device before upload for a fast header avatar.
profile.subtitle: Manage your photo, contact details, password, and UI preferences. Organizational access is controlled by workspace admins.
profile.adminHint: Need to edit roles or warehouse access?
profile.passwordDescription: Changing password signs out other sessions
profile.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in again on other devices.
profile.passwordFailed: Could not change password. Check your current password.

pageHelp.fallbackBody: No specialized playbook is registered for
pageHelp.fallbackHint: Prefer on-screen Undo, Cancel, or Un-allocate actions — never erase inventory history.

dashboard.title: Command Center
dashboard.description: Your daily overview of warehouse operations, active tasks, and system health.
dashboard.markdown: The dashboard monitors pending shipments, incoming deliveries, and worker velocity. Use the quick actions below to jump directly into your daily queue.
dashboard.purpose: See pending work, inbound freight, and labor at a glance so you can jump into today's queue.
dashboard.dataOrigin: Live warehouse and office activity summarized for your roles.

flow.0: Scan the KPIs for blocked orders, inbound, and labor.
flow.1: Open a quick action to jump into the matching queue.

reversals.0: The dashboard is read-only — reverse work on the operational page it links to.

correlations.0: Owners also see live paid-invoice signals from finance.

salesOrders.title: Sales Orders
salesOrders.description: Manage customer orders awaiting processing and shipment.
salesOrders.markdown: Orders drop in here from Shopify or B2B portals. To process an order, it must have sufficient inventory to be Allocated, after which it drops into the Fulfillment queue.

0.solution: You lack inventory for the requested items. Run a replenishment or adjust stock.

salesOrders.purpose: Confirm customer demand and allocate stock so orders can enter the fulfillment queue.
salesOrders.dataOrigin: Sales orders entered by the office team or synced from connected storefronts.

flow.0: Confirm the order.
flow.1: Allocate stock.
flow.2: Release into fulfillment.

reversals.0: Un-allocate releases reserved stock back to the pool.

correlations.0: Allocated orders drop into the Fulfillment wave queue.

fulfillment.title: Fulfillment & Picking
fulfillment.description: Group orders into waves, pick items from shelves, and pack them for shipping.
fulfillment.markdown:
Step 1: Generate a wave to group similar orders.
Step 2: Claim the wave to your scanner.
Step 3: Pick the items.
Step 4: Pack and print shipping labels.

0.solution: Flag the item as an exception. The system will direct you to pick a replacement.

fulfillment.purpose: Group orders into waves, pick from shelves, and pack for shipping.
fulfillment.dataOrigin: Allocated sales orders waiting to be picked and packed.

flow.0: Generate a wave.
flow.1: Claim the wave to your scanner.
flow.2: Pick, pack, and ship.

reversals.0: Un-allocate or exception the line rather than inventing a stock adjust.

correlations.0: Skip & Flag incidents land on the Exceptions desk.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase Orders
purchaseOrders.description: Order new stock from your suppliers.
purchaseOrders.markdown: Draft purchase orders to restock your warehouse. Once a PO is confirmed, the receiving dock will be notified to expect the delivery.
purchaseOrders.purpose: Order new stock from your suppliers and notify the receiving dock.

flow.0: Draft a PO.
flow.1: Confirm so receiving expects the delivery.

reversals.0: Cancel an unreceived PO; received lines reverse through returns or stock correction.

correlations.0: Confirmed POs appear on Inbound Receiving.

inboundReceive.title: Inbound Receiving
inboundReceive.description: Check in newly arrived inventory from suppliers.
inboundReceive.markdown: Scan the incoming Purchase Order, verify the physical quantities match the invoice, and generate License Plates (LPNs) to put the items away on shelves.

0.issue: The supplier sent more items than ordered (Over-receipt).
0.solution: Depending on your tolerance settings, you may need to file an RTV (Return to Vendor) or accept the surplus.

inboundReceive.purpose: Check in newly arrived inventory from suppliers and generate LPNs for putaway.
inboundReceive.dataOrigin: Inbound receipts against confirmed purchase orders.

flow.0: Scan the incoming PO.
flow.1: Verify quantities.
flow.2: Generate LPNs and start put-away.

reversals.0: Use the undo window before commit; after commit reverse via RTV or stock correction.

correlations.0: Over-receipts may require a return-to-vendor.

products.title: Product Catalog
products.description: The master database of everything you sell and store.
products.markdown: Manage SKUs, barcodes, Unit of Measure (UoM) conversions, and product imagery. Changes here sync globally across all facilities.
products.purpose: The master catalog of everything you sell and store.
products.dataOrigin: Product catalog with current on-hand quantities.

flow.0: Add or edit a SKU.
flow.1: Set barcodes and units.
flow.2: Import from CSV when loading many rows.

reversals.0: Edit the master again; catalog edits do not erase stock history.

correlations.0: Changes sync across facilities and feed barcode resolution on the floor.

cycleCounts.title: Cycle Counts
cycleCounts.description: Audit your physical shelves to ensure software accuracy.
cycleCounts.markdown: Generate blind counts for your team. If the physical count differs from the software ledger, a manager must approve the variance.
cycleCounts.purpose: Blind physical counts that reconcile on-hand to reality.
cycleCounts.dataOrigin: Cycle count worksheets and variance approvals.

flow.0: Open a count task (expected qty hidden).
flow.1: Enter the physical quantity.
flow.2: Managers approve large variances.

reversals.0: Before confirm, clear the entry and re-count.
reversals.1: After an auto-adjust, reverse with a manager stock correction.

correlations.0: Approved counts write a stock correction and refresh on-hand quantities.

exceptions.title: Exceptions Desk
exceptions.description: Resolve hardware conflicts, damaged goods, and picking errors.
exceptions.markdown: When workers flag issues on the floor or devices lose internet connection, the errors land here for management resolution.
exceptions.purpose: Resolve floor Skip & Flag incidents and parked offline scan conflicts.
exceptions.dataOrigin: Lines pickers marked as Skip & Flag and parked offline scans.

flow.0: Open an OPEN fulfillment exception.
flow.1: Investigate, then Resolve with disposition.
flow.2: On Sync Conflicts, Approve & Re-process or Discard.

reversals.0: Resolving an exception does not automatically restore the original allocation.

correlations.0: Pickers create exceptions to keep waves moving; managers close the loop.

settings.title: Tenant Settings
settings.description: Configure integrations, hardware, and access controls.
settings.markdown: Manage your connected Shopify stores, configure Bluetooth scales and Zebra scanners, and define Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) permissions for your staff.
settings.purpose: Tenant-wide configuration hub for users, warehouses, floor rules, and integrations.

flow.0: Open the tab that matches the change you need.
flow.1: Save — the audit log records the actor.
flow.2: Confirm floor devices pick up the new rule.

reversals.0: Toggle the rule back; every change is recorded in the audit history.

correlations.0: Blind receiving and variance thresholds change what pickers may post without manager review.

inventory_ledger.title: Inventory Ledger
inventory_ledger.description: Review stock movements. History is never erased — corrections add a new row.
inventory_ledger.purpose: Review stock movements (receive, adjust, ship, transfer, assemble). History is never erased — corrections add a new row.
inventory_ledger.markdown: Filter movements, open a row for reason and actor, and reverse only with the built-in Undo when policy allows.
inventory_ledger.dataOrigin: Stock movement history shown for managers (every receive, pick, and adjust).

flow.0: Filter by SKU, location, date, or movement type.
flow.1: Open a row to see reason code, actor, lot/serial, and references.
flow.2: Use Undo only on reversible rows when policy allows.

reversals.0: Prefer the built-in Undo — it posts a compensating stock correction attributed to you.
reversals.1: Never delete historical stock movements.
reversals.2: If Undo is hidden, post an explicit stock correction with a clear reason.

correlations.0: Every floor scan and office allocate/ship eventually appears here.
correlations.1: Lot Trace walks these rows for recall response.

replenishments.title: Replenishments
replenishments.description: Move stock from reserve into pick faces so outbound waves do not starve.
replenishments.purpose: Move stock from reserve/bulk into pick faces so outbound waves do not starve.
replenishments.markdown: Review suggested moves, scan source then destination, and confirm the transfer.
replenishments.dataOrigin: Suggested moves from reserve storage into pick faces.

flow.0: Review suggested movements (min/max rules + predictive triggers).
flow.1: Scan source, scan destination, confirm the transfer.

reversals.0: Before confirm, cancel the task.
reversals.1: After confirm, reverse with an opposite transfer documented as a replenishment correction.

correlations.0: Prevents pick-line stockouts that would otherwise become Skip & Flag exceptions.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Maintain customer master data and credit lines that gate outbound allocation.
customers.purpose: Maintain customer master data and credit lines that gate outbound allocation.
customers.markdown: Create or edit a customer, set the credit limit, and link ship-to addresses used on sales orders.
customers.dataOrigin: Customer records maintained by your office team.

flow.0: Create or edit a customer profile.
flow.1: Set or adjust the line-of-credit limit.
flow.2: Link ship-to addresses used on sales orders.

reversals.0: Credit limit changes take effect on the next allocate.
reversals.1: Deactivating a customer does not cancel open sales orders.

correlations.0: Over-limit allocate attempts freeze orders for review.
correlations.1: B2B showroom price lists bind to these customer records.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Track invoices and payment state; when a payment clears, the invoice shows PAID.
invoices.purpose: Track invoices and payment state; when a payment clears, the invoice shows PAID for finance.
invoices.markdown: Review AR aging, send payment requests when configured, and watch live PAID updates after settlement.
invoices.dataOrigin: Invoices created after orders ship or are ready to bill.

flow.0: Review AR aging and open invoices.
flow.1: Send payment requests when configured.
flow.2: Watch live PAID updates after payment settles.

reversals.0: Do not manually flip PAID without a finance process.
reversals.1: Refunds are accounting events; stock returns use the Returns module.

correlations.0: Paid invoices may release credit exposure for new allocations.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Vendor master — terms, lead times, quality ratings, and masked banking details.
suppliers.purpose: Vendor master — terms, lead times, quality ratings, and envelope-encrypted banking details.
suppliers.markdown: Create or edit a supplier, set lead times for replenishment planning, and store banking details (masked after save).

flow.0: Create or edit a supplier profile.
flow.1: Set lead times that feed replenishment planning.
flow.2: Store banking details (shown masked after save).

reversals.0: Correct master data with another edit.
reversals.1: Deactivate rather than delete suppliers tied to historical POs.

correlations.0: PO creation requires an approved supplier.
correlations.1: Lead times influence automated replenishment suggestions.

returns.title: Returns / RMA
returns.description: Authorize customer returns, then receive and disposition (restock vs scrap) on the floor.
returns.purpose: Authorize customer returns, then receive and disposition (restock vs scrap) on the floor.
returns.markdown: Create and approve an RMA, receive against it on the floor, then restock or scrap.

flow.0: Create and approve an RMA in the office.
flow.1: Floor receives against the RMA on Receive Returns.
flow.2: Disposition RESTOCK or SCRAP.

reversals.0: Cancel an unreceived RMA before floor intake.
reversals.1: Restocked units that should not sell: move back to quarantine or scrap with a stock correction.

correlations.0: Restock increases sellable ATP; scrap does not.
correlations.1: Finance may issue credits separately from inventory disposition.

returns_receive.title: Returns Receive (Floor)
returns_receive.description: Scan returned goods against an approved RMA and apply quarantine-aware disposition.
returns_receive.purpose: Scan returned goods against an approved RMA and apply quarantine-aware disposition.
returns_receive.markdown: Open the RMA on the handheld, scan the item, and complete putaway to quarantine or scrap as directed.
returns_receive.dataOrigin: Return receipts scanned on the floor.

flow.0: Open the RMA on the handheld.
flow.1: Scan the returned item and confirm disposition path.
flow.2: Complete putaway to quarantine or scrap location as directed.

reversals.0: Mis-scan undo window applies before commit.
reversals.1: After restock, only managers release or scrap with attributed ledger moves.

correlations.0: Closes RMA lines visible to office Returns.
correlations.1: Quarantine release is an office decision.

compliance_lot_trace.title: Lot Trace
compliance_lot_trace.description: Read-only genealogy of a lot or serial for recall and quality response.
compliance_lot_trace.purpose: Read-only genealogy of a lot/serial across supplier, receive, assembly, ship, and customer.
compliance_lot_trace.markdown: Enter the lot or serial, review the chain, and export CSV for regulators when needed.
compliance_lot_trace.dataOrigin: Lot and serial history for recalls and quality checks.

flow.0: Enter the lot or serial number.
flow.1: Review the recursive ledger chain.
flow.2: Export CSV for regulators or customers when needed.

reversals.0: Lot Trace is read-only — nothing to undo here.
reversals.1: Correct source data via returns, adjusts, or re-ship elsewhere.

correlations.0: VIEWER role is enough; operational roles write the underlying history.

rtls.title: RTLS map
rtls.description: Spatial digital twin — live picker positions, congestion heat, and walkable edges.
rtls.purpose: Spatial digital twin — live picker positions, congestion heat, and walkable edges for wayfinding.
rtls.markdown: Open the map, watch live positions, inspect the heatmap, and adjust coordinates when the layout changes.
rtls.dataOrigin: Live device or asset positions on the warehouse map.

flow.0: Open the map and watch live position updates.
flow.1: Inspect the 7-day heatmap of stock movement activity.
flow.2: Adjust coordinates / edges when the physical layout changes.

reversals.0: Coordinate edits can be patched again; they do not reverse inventory.
reversals.1: Heatmap history is analytical — not a transaction log to undo.

correlations.0: Pick pathing consumes this graph.
correlations.1: Floor scans feed both ledger heat and live tags.

manufacturing_boms.title: Bills of Materials
manufacturing_boms.description: Define assembly recipes that drive production orders.
manufacturing_boms.purpose: Define assembly recipes (components, operations, co-products) that drive production orders.
manufacturing_boms.markdown: Create a BOM for a finished SKU, add component lines and operations, then save.
manufacturing_boms.dataOrigin: Bills of materials that define what goes into a finished good.

flow.0: Create a BOM for a finished SKU.
flow.1: Add component lines, operations, and outputs.
flow.2: Save — production orders will consume this recipe.

reversals.0: Edit or version the BOM before orders allocate against it.
reversals.1: After production has run, supersede with a new revision instead of deleting history.

correlations.0: Component availability is checked when production orders allocate.

manufacturing_orders.title: Production Orders
manufacturing_orders.description: Schedule work orders and allocate raw components so sales picks cannot steal reserved materials.
manufacturing_orders.purpose: Schedule work orders and allocate raw components so sales picks cannot steal reserved materials.
manufacturing_orders.markdown: Create a production order from a BOM, allocate components, then release to the Production Terminal.

flow.0: Create a production order from a BOM.
flow.1: Allocate components.
flow.2: Release to the Production Terminal for assembly.

reversals.0: Deallocate components before assembly to return raw materials to ATP.
reversals.1: After assemble posts, reverse with compensating entries — never erase completed production history.

correlations.0: Locks components away from outbound sales picks.
correlations.1: Terminal labor timesheets attach cost to the order.

manufacturing_terminal.title: Production Terminal
manufacturing_terminal.description: Floor assembly station — start/stop labor, consume components, mint finished-goods labels.
manufacturing_terminal.purpose: Floor assembly station — start/stop labor, consume components, mint finished goods labels.
manufacturing_terminal.markdown: Scan the work order, start the timesheet, complete the run, then stop and post assemble.
manufacturing_terminal.dataOrigin: Shop-floor terminal scan steps for production.

flow.0: Scan the work order and Start timesheet.
flow.1: Complete the assembly run.
flow.2: Stop timesheet and post assemble.

reversals.0: Stop a timesheet without assemble if the run aborts.
reversals.1: Wrong assemble: a manager posts a compensating assembly or stock correction.

correlations.0: Finished goods become allocatable for sales immediately after assemble.

issue_supplies.title: Issue Supplies
issue_supplies.description: Internal consumption against a cost center — deducts stockroom qty without a customer sales order.
issue_supplies.purpose: Internal consumption against a cost center — deducts stockroom qty without creating a customer SO.
issue_supplies.markdown: Select the cost center, scan the supply SKU, and confirm the issue.
issue_supplies.dataOrigin: Internal issue of supplies to cost centers or jobs.

flow.0: Select the cost center.
flow.1: Scan the supply SKU and confirm issue.

reversals.0: Before confirm, cancel the issue.
reversals.1: After confirm, reverse with a positive stock correction to the stockroom attributed to the manager.

correlations.0: Charges the cost center budget; does not affect customer allocations.

field_truck.title: Technician Truck
field_truck.description: Consume van stock on-site; low stock signals depot replenishment.
field_truck.purpose: Consume van stock (vehicle location) on-site; low stock signals depot replenishment.
field_truck.markdown: Scan components used on the job and confirm consumption from the assigned vehicle location.
field_truck.dataOrigin: Stock assigned to service trucks and field techs.

flow.0: Scan components used on the job.
flow.1: Confirm consumption from the assigned vehicle location.
flow.2: Work offline if needed — queue replays on reconnect.

reversals.0: Undo window before offline queue commit.
reversals.1: After sync, reverse via depot stock correction or transfer back onto the van.

correlations.0: Reorder-point triggers truck replenishment from the warehouse.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Financial and operational analytics over warehouse data in your access scope.
reports.purpose: Financial and operational analytics (profit, COGS, turns) over warehouse data in your access scope.
reports.markdown: Open the analysis board you need, filter by date or warehouse, then export for leadership packs.
reports.dataOrigin: Saved operational reports and KPI snapshots.

flow.0: Open the analysis board you need.
flow.1: Filter by date / warehouse.
flow.2: Export or screenshot for leadership packs.

reversals.0: Reports are read-only — reverse underlying transactions on operational pages.

correlations.0: Headline KPIs may refresh on a short delay rather than updating every second.

settings_tab_profile.title: Settings — Profile
settings_tab_profile.description: Your user profile and the default organization name.
settings_tab_profile.purpose: Your user profile and the default organization name shown across the app.
settings_tab_profile.markdown: Update display name, contact, and locale preferences, then save.

flow.0: Update display name, contact, and locale preferences.
flow.1: Save — changes apply to your session immediately.

reversals.0: Edit the fields again; profile edits do not touch inventory or roles.

correlations.0: Org branding may also appear on documents from the Documents tab.

settings_tab_users.title: Settings — Users
settings_tab_users.description: Invite users, assign roles, and scope warehouse access.
settings_tab_users.purpose: Invite and manage company users, assign roles, and scope which warehouses each person can access.
settings_tab_users.markdown: Invite a user, assign roles that match their job, check warehouses they may access, then save.

flow.0: Invite a user or open an existing account.
flow.1: Assign one or more roles that match their job.
flow.2: Check the warehouses they may access.
flow.3: Save — the next login enforces the new capabilities.

reversals.0: Remove a role or warehouse checkbox and save again.
reversals.1: Deactivate rather than delete users tied to historical stock movements.

correlations.0: Warehouse assignments control which bins, waves, and documents appear.

settings_tab_warehouses.title: Settings — Warehouses
settings_tab_warehouses.description: Define buildings, zones, and bins used by access and putaway rules.
settings_tab_warehouses.purpose: Define buildings, zones, and bins that warehouse access and putaway rules reference.
settings_tab_warehouses.markdown: Add or edit a warehouse, maintain zones/bins, and assign users from the Users tab.
settings_tab_warehouses.dataOrigin: Warehouses and bin locations for your company.

flow.0: Add or edit a warehouse.
flow.1: Maintain zones/bins (or open the visualizer).
flow.2: Assign users to the warehouse from the Users tab.

reversals.0: Deactivate unused warehouses instead of deleting ones with ledger history.
reversals.1: Bin coordinate edits do not reverse stock.

correlations.0: Pick pathing, RTLS, and replenishment depend on this layout.

settings_tab_inventory.title: Settings — Inventory Rules
settings_tab_inventory.description: Reorder points, UOM defaults, and inventory policy knobs.
settings_tab_inventory.purpose: Reorder points, UOM defaults, and inventory policy knobs that feed ATP and replenishment.
settings_tab_inventory.markdown: Adjust reorder / safety-stock defaults, then save so planning picks up the new thresholds.
settings_tab_inventory.dataOrigin: Inventory policy settings (reorder rules, units, and similar).

flow.0: Adjust reorder / safety-stock defaults as needed.
flow.1: Save — planning and low-stock KPIs pick up the new thresholds.

reversals.0: Restore prior thresholds with another save.

correlations.0: Dashboard Low Stock Count and purchase suggestions use these thresholds.

settings_tab_documents.title: Settings — Documents
settings_tab_documents.description: Templates and numbering for POs, packing slips, invoices, and other printables.
settings_tab_documents.purpose: Templates and numbering for POs, packing slips, invoices, and other printable documents.
settings_tab_documents.markdown: Pick the document type, update logo or number series, then save.

flow.0: Pick the document type to customize.
flow.1: Update logo, footer, or number series.
flow.2: Save — next print jobs use the new template.

reversals.0: Revert template fields and save again; already-printed PDFs are not rewritten.

correlations.0: Sales ship and PO submit flows render from these templates.

settings_tab_security.title: Settings — Security & SSO
settings_tab_security.description: SSO, session policy, and authentication hardening for the tenant.
settings_tab_security.purpose: SSO configuration, session policy, and authentication hardening for the tenant.
settings_tab_security.markdown: Configure SSO if your IdP is ready, review session toggles, then save.
settings_tab_security.dataOrigin: Sign-in and security options for your company.

flow.0: Configure SSO provider fields if your IdP is ready.
flow.1: Review session / MFA related toggles.
flow.2: Save — next login follows the new policy.

reversals.0: Disable SSO carefully — ensure local login still works for admins.
reversals.1: Every security change is audited.

correlations.0: Affects how owners, admins, and pickers sign in; does not change warehouse access by itself.

settings_tab_reconciliation.title: Settings — Reconciliation
settings_tab_reconciliation.description: Tools and schedules for reconciling inventory and external books.
settings_tab_reconciliation.purpose: Tools and schedules for reconciling inventory levels, accounting balances, and external sync ledgers.
settings_tab_reconciliation.markdown: Review the last run, trigger a reconcile when finance asks, then investigate mismatches on operational pages.
settings_tab_reconciliation.dataOrigin: Comparisons between this system and connected storefronts.

flow.0: Review the last reconciliation run.
flow.1: Trigger or schedule a reconcile when finance asks.
flow.2: Investigate mismatches on the linked operational pages.

reversals.0: Reconciliation jobs do not delete ledger rows — they report drift for manager stock correction.

correlations.0: Pairs with Accounting Sync and Cycle Counts when numbers disagree.

settings_tab_accounting.title: Settings — Accounting Sync
settings_tab_accounting.description: Connect QuickBooks/Xero so invoices and journals flow through finance sync.
settings_tab_accounting.purpose: Connect QuickBooks/Xero (or similar) so invoices and journals flow through the finance sync.
settings_tab_accounting.markdown: Connect or refresh the accounting adapter, map tax schemes, and retry FAILED rows.
settings_tab_accounting.dataOrigin: Accounting export status for finance systems.

flow.0: Connect or refresh the accounting adapter.
flow.1: Map tax schemes and accounts as prompted.
flow.2: Watch sync status chips for FAILED rows and retry.

reversals.0: Disconnecting stops new syncs; already-posted external journals must be voided in the accounting system.

correlations.0: Paid invoices and COGS journals depend on this bridge.

settings_tab_integrations.title: Settings — Integrations
settings_tab_integrations.description: Connect storefronts and accounting so orders and payments land without double entry.
settings_tab_integrations.purpose: Connect e-commerce storefronts and accounting systems so orders and payments land without double entry.
settings_tab_integrations.markdown: Choose a connector, paste connection keys, enable the channel, and verify a test order or payment.

flow.0: Choose an e-commerce or accounting connector.
flow.1: Paste the connection keys provided by the storefront or accounting system.
flow.2: Enable the channel and verify a test order or payment event.

reversals.0: Disable a connector to stop inbound events; already-imported sales orders stay in the outbound pipeline.
reversals.1: Rotate connection keys if a key leaks.

correlations.0: Storefront connections create or update sales orders that still allocate and ship like office-entered orders.

settings_tab_mesh.title: Settings — Partner Catalog
settings_tab_mesh.description: Cross-tenant mappings so seller SKUs resolve to buyer products.
settings_tab_mesh.purpose: Cross-tenant mesh mappings so seller SKUs resolve to buyer products on multi-party POs/SOs.
settings_tab_mesh.markdown: Open Partner Catalog Mapping, map partner SKUs to local variants, then save.
settings_tab_mesh.dataOrigin: Partner catalog sharing between trusted companies.

flow.0: Open Partner Catalog Mapping.
flow.1: Map partner SKUs to local variants.
flow.2: Save — the mesh uses the map on the next purchase-order submit.

reversals.0: Unmap or remap a SKU; historical documents keep the snapshot they were created with.

correlations.0: Unmapped mesh lines may create DRAFT exception sales orders for review.

settings_tab_retailPos.title: Settings — Retail POS
settings_tab_retailPos.description: Receipt copy, register currency, CFDI facturación, and blind closeout.
settings_tab_retailPos.purpose: Configure the Retail POS addon — receipt branding, default currency, Mexican CFDI, and shift-end blind closeout.
settings_tab_retailPos.markdown: Set currency and CFDI, edit receipt header and footer, then save. Cashiers pick up the rules on the next register login.
settings_tab_retailPos.dataOrigin: Tenant Retail POS settings your administrators maintain.

flow.0: Choose the register default currency and whether CFDI 4.0 invoicing is on.
flow.1: Edit the receipt header and footer printed at checkout.
flow.2: Toggle blind closeout if cashiers must count the drawer without seeing the expected total.
flow.3: Save — the next POS session reads the updated tenant settings.

reversals.0: Edit the fields again and save; receipt text is not versioned on paper already printed.
reversals.1: Turning off CFDI does not void invoices already issued from the register.

correlations.0: Only tenants with the Retail POS module see this tab.
correlations.1: Blind closeout is a register guardrail, separate from warehouse blind cycle counts.

settings_tab_operations.title: Settings — Operations
settings_tab_operations.description: Floor rules — blind receiving, adjustment limits, scanner options — plus the Audit Log.
settings_tab_operations.purpose: Tenant floor rules — blind receiving, adjustment limits, scanner options — plus the Audit Log of who changed what.
settings_tab_operations.markdown: Toggle the operational rule you need, save, then confirm floor devices pick up the new rule.
settings_tab_operations.dataOrigin: Floor operating rules (receiving and scanner options).

flow.0: Toggle the operational rule you need (e.g. blind receiving, max adjust qty).
flow.1: Save — the audit log records the actor.
flow.2: Confirm floor devices pick up the new rule on the next scan.

reversals.0: Toggle the rule back; every change is recorded in the audit history.
reversals.1: Raising an adjustment limit does not auto-approve past pending manager review counts.

correlations.0: Blind receiving and variance thresholds change what pickers may post without manager review.

settings_tab_syncConflicts.title: Settings — Sync Conflicts
settings_tab_syncConflicts.description: Review parked offline floor scans that could not finish after reconnecting.
settings_tab_syncConflicts.purpose: Review parked offline floor scans that could not finish after reconnecting.
settings_tab_syncConflicts.markdown: Open a parked conflict, correct highlighted fields, then Approve & Re-process or Discard.
settings_tab_syncConflicts.dataOrigin: The conflict list on Dashboard or Exceptions.

flow.0: Open a PARKED conflict.
flow.1: Correct the highlighted fields if needed.
flow.2: Approve & Re-process or Discard.

reversals.0: Discard permanently drops the parked scan.
